title: AI RPG With Your Own Character: Parties, Stats, and Story
summary: AI RPGs that center your original character—structure, sheets, and when a cozy cast world fits better.
body_markdown:
> **Quick answer:** AI RPGs add structure—classes, inventories, quests—on top of generative story, and shine when *your* original character is the protagonist, not a borrowed celebrity bot.


Hub:[ai-dungeon-alternatives](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/ai-dungeon-alternatives)


Table of Contents


Toggle


##


What to look for


#


- Character creation you control
- Persistent progress
- Party or companion support
- Combat optional vs required


##


Original character angle


#


Name, look, backstory, speaking style—own them. For persona-style play across a cast, see also[Character AI alternative with personas](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/character-ai-alternative-with-personas) .


##


Soft bridge to Redbean


#


If what you want is less dice and more daily life with a cast you made, a pixel life-sim may fit better than a dungeon crawler. Redbean keeps the "my characters" promise in a cozy direction.


##


Sheet lite for RPG play


#


```text
Name:
Role:
Ability vibe (not a copyrighted class name):
Inventory (5 items max to start):
Bond:
Flaw:
```


Keep it light so you actually use it mid-session.


##


Keep notes outside the app


#


Whatever tool you try, keep a short external note with the character or pet name, the goal for this week, and three facts that must not drift. Apps change. Your notes travel.

##


Party roles without copyrighted class names


#


- The planner
- The heart
- The wildcard
- The historian


Define vibe, not a trademarked job title from a famous TTRPG.
